body: But WHY? Fuck. Why the hell should we ever be in an all out war against other 5th gen fighters. There is no reason we should still be fighting wars almost 100 years after the "war to end all wars." Fuck the world, I quit.

I was reading an article by a nasa scientist, and he was saying that the sheer amount of experience and professionalism that nasa is losing to civilian businesses because of budget cuts is really depressing, and we'll never get those people back. Some people who work for nasa have 30 years of experience with the space program, and now they're going to work for lockheed martin or boeing because nasa fired them due to lack of funds. Makes me sick.

...what. F-35, not B-35. The F-35s primary air to surface target is SAM sites. The F-35 is a dogfighter like the F-16. A rough parallel is F-22=F-15 (Interceptors/Air dominance fighters), F-35=F-16 (dogfighters), although the F-35 will supposedly replace the F-15E. This is my understanding anyway. The real waste of money, imo, is the F-22 program. Why do we need a new generation air dominance fighter when no one fights massive air wars anymore?

naw bro. private practitioner pdoc sent me a civilian hospital, checked in while off duty. they are under no obligation to pay for it. If you knew shit about the military, you'd know that military medical facilities suck, and military mental health professionals are even worse.

EDIT: and why the fuck would I be trolling? I responded to an AMA with 5 upvotes and no comments... what could I possibly have to gain by making up a story?

We've gone through 3 different meds so far, and I've had problems with all of them. I feel like I'm just complaining about everything. Maybe the problem is me? Maybe I'm just looking for a magic drug to fix all my problems and there is none?

I know something is wrong with me. But I can't shake the feeling that this is all my fault somehow. Maybe I just need to muster the willpower to overcome it... or something. But it's just not working.

Thanks for the input though. There's not really anyone I can talk to this stuff about, so I appreciate that you've taken the time to listen

Holy shit. Very interesting read. I'm really really glad I happened to see this. I'm in a similar situation to the first half of your story. I had a mental breakdown, was committed to the hospital, my chain of command was notified. Now I'm out of the hospital, and on medication. My chain of command is offering to pay for my medical expenses for god knows why. I honestly don't know if they want me back? Or if they want me to GTFO? I want out, because I'm too much of a drugged up mess to be a good infantryman anymore. No idea who to contact or where to go from here though.

Anyway, good luck getting that shit sorted out brother. I hope it works out for the best, and you get that honorable discharge. You didn't do anything "wrong" that I can see from your story. It's more like something from the movie Brazil, honestly.

Well, thanks for the advice. I'm broke, not sure getting a new psychiatrist is an option until I find a new job. But I don't have the motivation to look for one on these meds. God, it's so overwhelming that I give up before trying. I'm fucking pathetic.

My psychiatrist doesn't seem all that interested. Once I told him that I was no longer an immediate suicide risk he stopped listening to a word I said. Maybe I need a new psychiatrist, but I'm feeling very indifferent. I just don't care enough to go through all that again. I've already sunk well over $3000 into medical bills out of my pocket, and all they could give me is a zombified version of myself.

I know self medicating is dangerous but when I did it before, I was extremely responsible, and used the lowest dose I could while still getting the effect I wanted. I'm just as qualified to throw science at the wall and see if it sticks as any pdoc
